title: Fee Reversals, Late-Delivery Refunds and Returns — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Terms
content:
The following terms of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan govern fee reversals and the reversal of returned principal.

| Tier | Fee reversal request window (calendar days after a fee's entry date) | Courtesy fee reversals per 12 months | Instant fee reversed when delivery exceeded the delivery standard | Next-business-day fee reversed when delivered after the expected delivery date | Principal reversal (business days after a return or delivery failure notice) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 30 | 0 | yes | yes | 1 |
| Paystride Access Standard | 30 | 1 | yes | yes | 1 |
| Paystride Access Plus | 45 | 1 | yes | yes | 1 |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 45 | 2 | yes | yes | 1 |
| Paystride Access Premier | 60 | 2 | yes | yes | 1 |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 60 | 3 | yes | yes | 1 |

## Definitions

- **Request window** — the calendar days after a fee's entry date within which the worker may request its reversal.
- **Courtesy reversals** — the number of courtesy fee reversals the tier allows in twelve months.
- **Late instant refund** — whether an instant fee is reversed when delivery exceeded the delivery standard.
- **Late next-business-day refund** — whether a next-business-day fee is reversed when the transfer was delivered after its expected delivery date.
- **Principal reversal** — the business days after a return or delivery failure notice within which the principal is reversed.

## Points of reading

- Paystride Access Starter allows no courtesy reversal; the allowance is one on Paystride Access Standard and Paystride Access Plus, two on Paystride Access Preferred and Paystride Access Premier, and three on Paystride Access Premier Plus.
- The request window is 30 days on the two lower tiers, 45 on the middle two and 60 on the upper two.
- Late-delivery refunds of either speed and the one-business-day principal reversal apply on every tier.
